follow-up time: mean 6.5 years (range, 0.5-12 years) for open method and 1 year (range, 0.5-2 years) for laparoscopic approach
cohort: 194 women who underwent PLH (176 open and 18 laparoscopic)
finding: Open PLH for uterine prolapse may be safely performed and gives durable support to the prolapsed uterus with low recurrence risk.
mod_finding: 7 out of 10 uterine prolapse recurrences occurred after vaginal delivery.
